findings.rationale: The tf_s3_public_access fixture sets acl = 'public-read', and the ATT&CK lookup for T1530 describes collecting data from cloud storage, so the exposure permits unauthenticated object retrieval; high severity reflects direct, anonymous data access.

The tf_cloudtrail_disabled fixture sets enable_logging = false, and the ATT&CK lookup for T1562.008 describes impairing cloud logging, so the missing trail removes a key detective control; medium severity reflects a broad visibility gap without inherent data exposure.

The tf_iam_open fixture grants a wildcard trust principal, and the ATT&CK lookup for T1078 describes using valid accounts for access and persistence, so the policy permits any AWS principal to assume the role; high severity reflects broad, identity-based access.
